ellie_sales: Heads-up: Cerulean pilot escalated. They insist on HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2), strict egress cap for pilot, and a 99th%-ile chat latency <=80ms. Exec wants options doc by Mon. Who can own HSM flow + pricing?

vikram_se: I can own the tech flow. Important Q: remote HSM proxy vs imported-wrapped keys? Remote HSM is preferred by them. Need compatibility matrix.

zoe_infra: Remote HSM doable but will add signing latency. We should estimate cold vs warm path costs. Also need a dedicated canary in ap-southeast-1 for residency.

ellie_sales: Pilot numbers: ~8M tokens, full prod ~250M tokens. They want a fixed pilot cap and then committed spend talks.

claire_legal: I'll draft a BYO-HSM addendum with audit rights and attestation clauses. For export control in AP-SE, need to confirm with compliance.

robin_finance: For pilot cap we can offer a capped credit (10%) pending canary results. Any larger concession needs VP approval. I'll draft TCO with overage tiers.

vikram_se: I'll include two flows in the exec doc: (A) Remote HSM proxy + fallback to Redwood-managed tenant key, (B) Imported wrapped key for faster onboarding. Will include perf delta estimates.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-11200 created: Cerulean HSM connector + canary pool (assignee: zoe_infra).

zoe_infra: INF-11200: I'll post perf numbers and a short runbook by Thu. Need test HSM creds from Cerulean.

ellie_sales: Thanks — I'll schedule the exec call Mon 9am SGT. Please post deliverables by Sun EOD PT. :thumbsup:
